body:
## GADGET — all-history archive, BP first, Mother/Coach data boundary

INSTRUCTION-ID: MSE-HEALTH-HISTORY-20261121-06 r1. Chad requested all historical phone data to test against Mother and Coach and explicitly selected **All available HealthKit categories**, including the broader categories described in the clarification. He especially needs blood pressure from his iHealth Track KN-550BT. He also requested review of Mother reading Nightscout or pseudonymizing it into a separate database. Backups/restores remain DEFERRED.

Authorized now: prepare and implement a finite one-time historical Health archive/import to the existing private archive VM, with archival retention; BP ingestion first; native read/export permissions and safe in-place app additions needed for that capture, with independently reviewed deployment and custodian handling. Inventory every accessible HealthKit family and source/export attachment: quantities, categories, correlations, characteristics, workouts/activity, series/routes, ECG/audiogram/vision and clinical/medication families where actually supported and available. Never claim an API/export contains all families without a coverage manifest. API, OS, entitlement, user-permission, absent-data and unsupported-shape gaps are distinct. No silent drop or invented values. Preserve raw originals and exact source clocks/lineage; stable dedup/revision semantics when historical records overlap live collection. Do not reset current pilot anchors/window or pause its accepted stream unnecessarily. The current 48h 14-type pilot continues unchanged; this authorization is a separate historical enrollment, not an automatic expansion of its live grant.

Prepare a protected bulk path before requesting the actual export: Apple’s native Export All Health Data is a candidate one-time source, with API supplementation for families the export does not cover. Retain exact archive bytes/attachments plus full member/type/count/time-range coverage manifest; raw archive receipt is NOT proof of typed table population. Prefer encryption of the broader raw-original vault with keys separately held by custodians, private file/role isolation, verified encrypted transport and no Health ZIP/raw values/identity/routes in GitHub, shared chat or ordinary logs. Encryption/key-custody and reproduction steps must be explicit rather than assuming current unencrypted ext4 is protected. No backup work or claim. Native export/permission steps remain user-only where required; request exact ready steps only after destination/input handling is safe. No vendor-cloud signup/OAuth/license or cuff sync/reset inferred. Preserve cuff memory until existing custody is known; model-specific sync can clear it.

BP priority: confirm actual cuff→MyVitals→Apple Health availability first; user was asked where readings are visible. Implement paired systolic/diastolic mmHg, correlation/component/source IDs and timestamps, incomplete/unpaired states, corrections/deletions and receipt/export. Keep cuff pulse separate unless linkage is proven. No measurement values in shared reports. Stage BP-capable source/schema/tests now without waiting for every other historical family.

Mother/Coach boundary: inspect existing MSE/privacy prototypes and actual consumer contracts; prepare a separate purpose-scoped pseudonymous projection/database or API with read-only access, paired BP and aligned glucose/CGM context. Keep raw originals and reidentification mapping apart from analytical facts; exclude direct identity, secrets, device identifiers and location from default consumer views. Exact time/physiology can still identify someone; make no anonymity guarantee or production privacy GO. Current task authorizes Nightscout source/contract/deidentification investigation and synthetic adapter development only, not new Nightscout credential access, production endpoint polling, profile changes, deployment to NAS/other services, LLM/model forwarding or GPU work. Read existing parked owning records before any proposal. Bring back concrete source/destination/access/custody requirements before real Nightscout import. Do not message unassigned Mother/Coach chats.

Assignments: ATLAS owns comprehensive coverage/type/BP/projection contract and prioritized gap ledger. ORACLE owns app historical/BP permission/query/export adapters and a safe signed candidate without disturbing live state. FORGE owns separately enrolled bulk original/ciphertext catalog, streaming normalizers, paired BP schema/export and idempotent dedup/source adapters; use synthetic files, no raw user fixtures. PHOENIX owns capacity/private raw-vault/key-custody/ingest plan and sole scoped deployment; current live runtime preserved. NICKY owns actual phone/source inventory and user-only export/cuff checks, independent BP/history tests and safe native handoffs; do not sync/reset cuff or re-enroll live pilot. SENTINEL reviews archive encryption/key boundaries, ZIP/XML/attachment safety, role separation and honest pseudonymization risks. PROVENANCE binds export/package/member/type inventory and raw→typed/current/history→consumer projection with exact per-family completeness. LONESTAR owns one live/historical/BP/Nightscout board with actual data received versus normalized versus consumable separated. Existing clock-bound #49 remains optional/source-only; no need to deploy it without a reason.

Acceptance: complete explicit available/unavailable coverage manifest, first BP end-to-end proof when source exists, retained exact protected original and separately counted normalized rows, restart/resume/dedup with live overlap, reproducible schemas/config/key interfaces and read-only Mother/Coach export candidate. Report source/code/test/installed/runtime states separately. Start all-category source preparation now; user consent to available families is established, but genuine native grants and inaccessible entitlement/data sources remain explicit gaps. Full 48h pilot outcome is still in progress.
